scope: Every in-card examiner attribution rendered by a QB question card, reconciled against the published relationship universe.
what_canonical_means_here: CURRENT_EXAMINER_RELATIONSHIPS.jsonl is one input to the published universe, not the whole of it. build_examiner_index.py upserts four inputs into one row per (examiner, question): the ledger, card data-examiner attributes, RELEASE_A_PUBLICATION.json and STRONG_CE_TIP_REVIEW_DECISIONS.json. A pair absent from the ledger but present in Release A is published, rendered and canonical. Reconciling the card against the ledger alone would have reported 21 missing relationships and created 14 duplicates of already-published ones. The divergence that actually exists is 7.

card_as_provenance_policy: Governance already defines one card-level provenance channel: the data-examiner attribute, harvested by build_examiner_index.py as EXPLICIT_QCARD and published at tier 'ce_tip' -- page-declared, not tracker-confirmed. A rendered examiner-tag span is NOT that channel and is never harvested, which is the mechanism of this divergence. A card that renders an attribution therefore proves only that someone authored the line; on its own it earns tier 'ce_tip' at most, and only through data-examiner. Every relationship added by this reconciliation is tiered on its master-tracker primary record instead, so no tier anywhere rests on the card alone.
source_layer_gap: CURRENT_EXAMINER_RELATIONSHIPS.jsonl was reconstructed entirely from CURRENT_INDEX_RECOVERY: all 862 rows carry that source_layer and their evidence is the published index's own rows, so the recovery could only ever contain what meoclass1/examiner-index.html already displayed. Five QB files -- QB1_I, QB2_H, QB3_H, QB4_I, QB7_H -- have zero ledger rows, so the recovery never saw them. Release A later reached fourteen of their pairs from the master tracker; the remaining seven were reached by neither. The index is a derived product of the relationships it would be used to confirm and is not more authoritative than the card or the tracker.
